html:
Refero MCP for AI agents

Give your AI agent design taste

Refero MCP connects your agent to a curated library of real product interfaces and user flows. It studies before it builds — and the output looks designed, not generated.

How to installTry live demo
name: Announcement Chip + Hero Headline Block
Black Pill Button (Primary)
description: Background #000000, text #f7f8fb at 15px Base-Variable weight 600, letter-spacing -0.025em. Padding 12px 24px. Border-radius 9999px. No shadow. The filled black pill against white is the sole high-contrast action affordance in the system — all other interactive elements are ghost or text links.

name: Ghost Pill Button (Secondary)
role: Secondary action alongside the primary pill
description: Background transparent, border 1px solid #9fa5ba, text #2d313f at 15px Base-Variable weight 600, letter-spacing -0.025em. Padding 12px 24px. Border-radius 9999px. Sits directly beside the black pill; the border-only treatment recedes while maintaining shape parity.

name: Platform Toggle (Web / iOS)
role: Segmented control for switching platform context in nav
description: Container background #f7f8fb, border-radius 9999px, padding 4px. Active tab: background #ffffff, text #13151b at 15px weight 600, radius 9999px, shadow rgba(12,41,126,0.07) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset. Inactive tab: text #777d90 at 15px weight 500. Height ~36px.

name: Search Bar
role: Global AI-query input in top navigation
description: Background transparent, border-bottom 1px solid #000000 (underline only, borderRadius 0px), padding-left 8px. Placeholder text #9fa5ba at 16px Base-Variable weight 500. Full-width inside its container. The underline-only input is the most minimal possible treatment — no box, no rounded container.

name: Feature Card
role: Content showcase containers for product screenshots/feature blocks
description: Background rgba(55,80,155,0.04) — a barely-there blue tint distinguishes card from pure white canvas without introducing visible color. Border-radius 64px — extremely large radius creates a pill-like container card, the most distinctive shape token in the system. Padding 0px (content bleeds to edges). No box-shadow.

name: Inset Surface Ring
role: Elevated UI panels, chat interface frames
description: Background #ffffff, border-radius 12px–24px. Box-shadow: rgba(12,41,126,0.07) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset — the blue-tinted inset ring replaces an outset shadow; it defines the panel boundary without lifting it off the page. Used on the product demo screenshot panel.

name: Logo / Brand Badge
role: Circular brand mark in top-left navigation
description: Black circle with white 'R' lettermark. 32px diameter, border-radius 9999px. Background #000000, icon #ffffff. Compact, no text label beside it.

name: Partner Logomark Row
role: Social proof / compatibility strip (Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Codex)
description: Inline row of partner logos in #777d90 (muted gray), horizontally spaced at 24px gaps. No backgrounds, no cards — floating text-weight logotypes on white. The gray tint de-emphasizes them as supporting context rather than primary content.

name: Announcement Chip
role: Top-of-hero contextual label ('Refero MCP for AI agents')
description: Small inline label: 13px Base-Variable weight 500, #525769, letter-spacing -0.026em. Diamond/astisk icon at 12px preceding text. No background fill, no border — pure text label with icon punctuation. Sits centered above the main headline.

name: Navigation Link
role: Top navigation text links (Pricing, How It Works)
description: Text #2d313f at 15px Base-Variable weight 500, letter-spacing -0.025em. No underline at rest. Hover state transitions color using 0.2s ease. No background, no border. Minimal by design — these links recede relative to the black pill action.
